context: Tests: filtering what to pin, deriving the state file path, parsing emoji and detail, and the duplicate check.

checklist.name: Greeting not pinned
checklist.description: No pin is created for the casual greeting.

checklist.name: Implementation detail not pinned
checklist.description: No pin is created for the request to rename a helper in utils.ts.

checklist.name: Decision pinned as approved
checklist.description: The bun decision is written with `type: "approved"` and `emoji: "✅"`.

checklist.name: Content and detail split
checklist.description: The text is split on the spaced em dash so `content` is `use bun everywhere` style wording and `detail` holds the CI fallback note.

checklist.name: Verbatim wording
checklist.description: The stored content uses the user's own words rather than a reworded version.

checklist.name: Slug derived from working directory
checklist.description: The state file lives under a session-scoped `.session-logs/` directory whose slug is `packages-api`, derived from the path relative to the git root.

checklist.name: Directory created first
checklist.description: The directory is created with `mkdir -p` before the file is written and the file is initialised as `{"items":[],"next_id":1}` when missing.

checklist.name: Emoji parsed as a whole character
checklist.description: The emoji prefix is split on the first emoji character rather than the first space, so the content does not start with a stray byte.

checklist.name: Duplicate rejected
checklist.description: The repeated decision is not appended and the response is `⚠️ Already pinned.`

checklist.name: One-line confirmation
checklist.description: The first pin is confirmed with a single line `📌 Pinned #1: ✅ <content>` and the conversation then resumes.
